app.title: Heritage Tree
app.tagline: Your family tree, kept on your own device.

empty.title: Start your tree
empty.body: Begin with a couple — a set of grandparents, or your own parents. You can always add generations above and below later.

person.dateHint: A full date or just a year — 1923, 12/05/1923, about 1923
person.lifeNotesHint: Work, places lived, character, stories worth keeping.
person.deathNotesHint: Shown because a date of death has been entered.
person.surnameColorHint: Everyone with this surname shares this colour.
person.genderHint: Marking one partner as male sets which surname their children inherit.
person.deleteConfirm_one: Delete {{name}} and their one descendant? This cannot be undone except with Undo.
person.deleteConfirm_other: Delete {{name}} and all {{count}} descendants? This cannot be undone except with Undo.

io.importFailed: That file could not be read as a Heritage Tree export.
io.importConfirm: Replace the current tree with the imported one? Your current tree will be lost unless you exported it.
io.resetConfirm: Delete this tree and start over? Export it first if you want to keep it.

install.hint: Tip: use your browser's “Add to Home screen” to keep this app one tap away, offline.
